node.title: Re^3: Safely removing Unicode zero-width spaces and other non-printing characters
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The source of the data is a large number of RSS feeds used which point to an even larger number of individual web pages.

Well, RSS is XML, and XML files should specify the encoding in the XML declaration, and XML parsers such as [mod://XML::LibXML] do respect that declaration. However, it's possible that the XML declaration is missing or incorrect. In cases like that, one thing you might try is [doc://Encode::Guess], keeping in mind that it's just a guess. Or, if you're getting these feeds from web servers, you might look at the response headers for a hint.
